apps.localizedDescription:
Apps2Samsung installs Jellyfin and other web and community apps onto your Samsung Tizen TV — no PC, no Tizen Studio, and no manual sideloading.

This is the mobile (phone) installer head of Apps2Samsung. Put your TV into Developer Mode, point the app at it over your local network, sign in once with a free Samsung account to provision a signing certificate, and install.

Features:

* Finds Samsung Tizen TVs on your network, or connect directly by IP.
* Installs Jellyfin (multiple build variants) and a catalog of community apps.
* Give any app a custom launcher icon and a custom title.
* Optional Jellyfin server pre-configuration: server URL, auto-login, and custom CSS.
* Uses a free Samsung account certificate — no paid developer account required.

Requirements:

* A Samsung Tizen TV in Developer Mode, on the same local network as your phone.

Desktop versions for Windows, macOS and Linux are also available. Apps2Samsung is free and open source (GPL-3.0).

versions.localizedDescription:
## 📦 v3.3.3-beta: 2026-11-24


### 🚀 New features
- Core: typed install failures, so a head can localize them (#1146) (#1151)
- Desktop: every install signs, the stock Jellyfin build with the shipped certificate (#1148) (#1152)
- Core: the desktop's recovery paths in PackageInstaller (#1147) (#1154)
- Desktop: install through Core PackageInstaller, the duplicate flow is gone (#1149) (#1156)
- Pick up a newer catalog while the app is open (#1157) (#1159)
- Core: read the end dates of the shipped authorities and fetch newer ones (#1153) (#1161)
- Desktop: ask before going on when the shipped certificates have ended (#1153) (#1163)
- The ended-certificates question in the CLI, on the phone and in Prepare the certificate now (#1153) (#1165)
- Refresh the catalog by hand, and On the TV starts over after a newer catalog (#1162) (#1166)
- Installed apps: offer Uninstall for the TV's own apps too (is_removable 0) (#1178)
- Saved TVs: a copy of each TV's app list as a file, by itself (#1180)
- Backup & restore: carry TV-Store's own data (A2SStore.backup / restore) (#1181)
- Automatic TV copies: take TV-Store's backup without keys from the TV by itself (#1186)
### 🐛 Bug fixes
- Strings: hardcoded English, singular app count, Remote and Back translations (#1126) (#1132)
- Mobile: reload the catalog, keyboards, confirmations, accessible names, monospace on iOS (#1127) (#1133)
- CLI: honest uninstall result, token off the screen, one-line errors with a hint, help for every verb (#1128) (#1134)
- Desktop polish: shortcuts, window placement remembered, accent toggles, older windows on the tokens (#1129) (#1135)
- Wider sidebar and text that fits, desktop and mobile (#1123, #1125) (#1131)
- Debug console: Attach service works while the app's console is open (#1140) (#1141)
- Sign a renamed or patched package again on Tizen 4.1 to 6.x, and fix the Tizen certificate sheet crash (#1143) (#1144)
- An empty translation is not a translation (#1167)
- Debug console: stop waiting forever on a TV that never answers the debug launch (#1174)
- Debug console: say a native app has no web inspector (#1176)
- Scan: no manufacturer lookup at macvendors.com (#1187)
### 🌍 Translations
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#1139)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#1168)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#1184)
- i18n: new translations from Crowdin (#1188)
### 🧰 Maintenance & CI
- CI: pin the .NET SDK to 10.0, the iOS job broke on a runner image with .NET 11 (#1142)
- CI: bump actions/setup-java from 6.2.0 to 6.3.0 in the actions group (#1173)
- deps: Bump the nuget group with 1 update (#1172)
- Code signing policy, privacy policy and SignPath attribution (#1182)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung/compare/v3.3.2-beta...v3.3.3-beta

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Apps2Samsung looks for Samsung TVs on your Wi-Fi network and talks to the TV you pick to install apps on it.
